response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.cost_ratio, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to a number before averaging.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice average quantities, as the request says, and not the mean over all lines.
A line with derived_total_cost of 0 gives a missing ratio (division by zero becomes NULL), and the average skips it.
